# package netstack

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/netstack"
```

Package netstack is a minimal IPv4 stack (ARP, IPv4 without fragments, UDP) on an [l2.Mux](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/l2#Mux). It gives a PROFINET endpoint on a virtual network the UDP sockets that RPC needs, so that every octet between a virtual controller and a virtual device — DCP, RT, alarms and RPC alike — is a serialized Ethernet frame that faults can be injected into and that Wireshark can dissect.

An address can be changed at run time with [Stack.SetAddr](#func-stack-setaddr), which is how a virtual IO-Device applies a DCP Set of its IP suite.

The stack is meant for virtual networks and tests. On a real interface use the operating system's stack (net.ListenPacket).

## Types

### type Config

```go
type Config struct {
	// Addr is the initial IPv4 address; the zero value leaves the stack
	// without an address until SetAddr (it answers no ARP and accepts
	// only broadcasts).
	Addr netip.Addr
	// Mask is the subnet mask, for example 255.255.255.0.
	Mask netip.Addr
	// Gateway is the default gateway; unset means none.
	Gateway netip.Addr
	// ARPTimeout bounds one address resolution. Zero means 1 s.
	ARPTimeout time.Duration
	// QueueLen is the receive queue length of each socket. Zero means
	// 64 datagrams.
	QueueLen int
}
```

Config configures a [Stack](#type-stack).

### type Stack

```go
type Stack struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

Stack is a minimal IPv4/UDP stack. It is safe for concurrent use.

#### func New

```go
func New(mux *l2.Mux, cfg Config) (*Stack, error)
```

New starts a stack on mux. The stack subscribes to IPv4 and ARP frames.

#### func (Stack) Addr

```go
func (s *Stack) Addr() (addr, mask, gw netip.Addr)
```

Addr returns the current address, mask and gateway.

#### func (Stack) Close

```go
func (s *Stack) Close() error
```

Close closes every socket and stops the stack.

#### func (Stack) ListenPacket

```go
func (s *Stack) ListenPacket(_ context.Context, network, address string) (net.PacketConn, error)
```

ListenPacket opens a UDP socket on the port of address, which has the form ":port" or "ip:port"; the IP is ignored. It matches the signature RPC endpoints take for opening their sockets.

#### func (Stack) ListenUDP

```go
func (s *Stack) ListenUDP(port uint16) (*PacketConn, error)
```

ListenUDP opens a UDP socket on port; 0 picks an ephemeral port.

#### func (Stack) SetAddr

```go
func (s *Stack) SetAddr(addr, mask, gw netip.Addr) error
```

SetAddr changes the address, mask and gateway. Zero values remove them. Sockets stay open; datagrams they send afterwards carry the new source address. The ARP cache is cleared.
